activity_summary: By candle, after Titus had ended without you, Heminges counted thirty-four shillings as the share. He said it had gone four. Last Saturday was thirty-five, and that sum is not this week's. The hired men's ten shillings were not taken out of the thirty-four. No coffer total was read. Next week is Errors on Monday, with you opening, the Two Gentlemen on Tuesday, and the king on Wednesday. The Rose title was Wise Man. There was no receipt. No fee was taken out of the share. You promised no errand and no unwritten line.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the thirty-four, and promised nothing unwritten.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Counted the share, kept last week separate, and shut the book without a total.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Measured thirty-four against thirty-five, and stayed on you.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Took his share, and left the court hours to Kettleby.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Set Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday, and set no errand.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: Last Saturday was thirty-five, and the week was no prettier.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Wise Man. That is the title I was given.
